points.description: States abstraction as an advantage of object-oriented programming (accept 'data abstraction', 'abstracting away implementation details', or equivalent wording).
States reusability as an advantage of object-oriented programming (accept 'reusable code', 'code reuse', or equivalent wording).

rubric.notes: Full marks require both abstraction and reusability. One correct advantage earns the marks for that point only. Unrelated OOP features or vague praise do not earn marks.
